info.about: Silent Hill: Book of Memories is a 2012 dungeon crawler game developed by WayForward Technologies and published by Konami. Released for the PlayStation Vita, it is a spin-off of the Silent Hill video game series.
info.trivia: It is the first Silent Hill game with multiplayer apart from Silent Hill: The Arcade, and Troy Baker co-wrote and sang on a soundtrack song.
info.why: As the only Silent Hill made for the Vita, it is the one series entry that completists can only own on a Vita game card.
